name: Summary Consumer
summary: Consumes deterministic bounded-period summaries derived from included and pending references.
description: Uses summary.aggregate to roll included and pending references into one bounded aggregate record with explicit counts, scope identity, and carry-forward facts. Needs deterministic period summaries without embedding visualization, storage, or policy routing into the capability.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes aggregates over references within a bounded scope, rather than finalizing the bounded period record itself.
Needs deterministic aggregate counts and references, rather than converting those counts into an uncertainty score.
